verdict.rationale: Inngest offers a REST API for pulling events, function runs, and traces programmatically (implying JSON export) and supports self-hosting so users aren't locked into the hosted platform, which mitigates lock-in for 'leaving.' However, there's no documented bulk data-export feature, no explicit open-format export tool, and community notes flag the license as SSPL 'source available' rather than fully open, undercutting the openness narrative. Missing for 10: a dedicated data export/backup feature, explicit open-format guarantees, and confirmation of full open-source licensing.
